overview_description.description:
Unframe is the Managed AI Transformation Platform that turns enterprise needs and use cases into fully tailored, production-ready AI solutions in days. Powered by Unframe's deep technical building blocks and its open platform, every solution integrates seamlessly with each customer's existing AI program and core systems — scoping, designing, and delivering against the company's data, workflows, and governance frameworks. Solutions run in the customer's cloud, on-premises, or as fully managed SaaS, with no dependency on a specific LLM. Unframe helps enterprises eliminate operational bottlenecks and capture the business value of AI, from targeted use cases to complete AI transformation.
Co-founded in 2024 by Shay Levi, Larissa Schneider, and Adi Azarya, Unframe is headquartered in Cupertino, California, with offices in Tel Aviv and Berlin. Visit unframe.ai.
